# Rivera Pools Riverside

> Rivera Pools Riverside is a licensed C-35 pool remodeling contractor serving Riverside County and nearby communities in Southern California.

Rivera Pools specializes in pool plastering, resurfacing, pool remodeling, leak detection, StoneScapes and pebble finishes, Diamond Brite, travertine coping, tile, equipment upgrades, and Baja shelf additions.
